content.text:
This structure is PKI-587 (gedatolisib), a urea with two para-substituted phenyl rings.

**Left side:** a 4-(dimethylamino)piperidine whose ring nitrogen is acylated. Its C=O is attached to a para-substituted phenyl ring, and that ring carries the urea NH at the para position.

**Centre:** the urea, written NC(=O)N.

**Right side:** a second para-substituted phenyl ring attached to a 1,3,5-triazine. The triazine carries two morpholine rings on its other two carbons, both attached through the morpholine nitrogen.

**SMILES assembly:**
- Left fragment: CN(C)C1CCN(CC1)C(=O)c1ccc(cc1)
- Urea: NC(=O)N
- Right fragment: c1ccc(cc1)-c1nc(nc(n1)N1CCOCC1)N1CCOCC1

Full SMILES: CN(C)C1CCN(CC1)C(=O)c1ccc(cc1)NC(=O)Nc1ccc(cc1)-c1nc(nc(n1)N1CCOCC1)N1CCOCC1
